description: This file defines the Font class used for handling font styling when writing Excel XLS files with PhpSpreadsheet. It includes methods for serializing font information into the BIFF format, including font size, color, boldness, underline style, and other attributes.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing font styling information into the BIFF format for XLS files, including font size, color, bold, underline, superscript/subscript, and other font attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Font object with a Style Font object.

methods.name: setColorIndex
methods.description: Sets the color index for the font.

methods.name: writeFont
methods.description: Generates the binary font record data for the BIFF format, including font attributes like size, color, bold, underline, superscript/subscript, etc.

methods.name: mapBold
methods.description: Maps boolean bold value to BIFF font weight codes.

methods.name: mapUnderline
methods.description: Maps underline style strings to BIFF underline style codes.

search-terms: Font size and color in XLS
